title: guapira leonis
intro: Guapira leonis, commonly known as Guapira, is a plant species within the family Nyctaginaceae. It has been found to possess various health benefits, including the ability to treat gastrointestinal issues, such as diarrhea and dysentery, due to its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents present in Guapira leonis include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and tannins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
